title: 第7章 师兄坟头草三丈唯美解师姐第8章 解采容师姐 我的废物师弟是个剑术高手
content_zh:
“许师弟，师兄告诉你一个好消息，大好的消息。”
许君白懒洋洋看着宋师兄，正所谓，无事不登三宝殿。
宋真罗师兄可是很少登门拜访的，三十年来，也不过来了几次而已。
灵药峰很危险，没有许君白的允许，不是谁都可以进入的，死都不知道怎么死的。
死了，也没地方哭诉，这地方，可是宗门重要地方，没有宗门允许想要进入其中，可就要面临着被杀的命运。
“见过宋师兄，不知道宋师兄有什么好消息告诉师弟？”
宋真罗师兄凑过来，低声说道：“许师弟，你知道吗？栾凌师弟回来了。”
许君白皱眉。
宋真罗师兄继续说：“就是那个栾凌师弟，他回来了，三天前回来了，我想师弟你肯定还不知道，师兄我知道消息的第一时间，特意来告诉师弟你，怎么样，师兄我够兄弟吧。”
许君白问道：“他回来了，然后呢。”
宋真罗笑嘻嘻道：“他死了，许师弟。”
许君白闻言，连忙摆手。
“人不是我杀的，宋师兄，你可不要污蔑我。”
宋真罗师兄一脸黑线，连忙开口：“行了，我知道不是你杀的，栾凌师兄在外突破纳魂，被妖族杀害了，要不是我们宗门的长辈去了，恐怕连他的尸体都见不到。”
“听说很惨，身躯都没了一半，死得不能再死了，宗门长辈也差点被留在那个地方，许师弟，你怎么了？”
“没什么。”许君白道：“师兄继续说。”
“妖族可真是可恶，他们竟然敢杀害我们白云派的弟子，这一次彻底惹怒了宗门的长辈，据说要安排弟子下山斩妖除魔。”
“我还听说了，每一个山峰的弟子都需要下山，由长辈带领着下山斩杀妖族。”
“这一次，我们周围的一些妖兽要遭殃了。”
许君白再次皱眉。

下山？斩妖除魔？
可不是他想要的。
“那师兄你也要下山？”
宋真罗摇摇头：“没有我等普通弟子的机会，都是那些弟子为了镀金，你懂得。”
许君白懂了，这一次下山斩妖除魔，贡献多，奖赏自然也多，这种有好处的事情，哪里轮得到他们这些没有后台的人，想要去，都不一定能去。
都是那些有后台的弟子下山斩妖除魔，走走过场，反正有长辈带着，不会有危险的。
基本上是稳妥的功劳，到时候拿到了一件灵器也不是不可能。
丹药灵器，奖赏不少，不少人都眼红呢。
却，去不了。
“师弟你想去？”
“不，我不想。”
“哈哈哈。”
content_en:
"Junior brother Xu, senior brother has a good news for you, great news."
Xu Junbai looked at Senior Brother Song lazily. As the saying goes, he would not go to the Three Treasures Hall for anything.
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo rarely visits. In the past thirty years, he has only come a few times.
Spiritual Medicine Peak is very dangerous. Not everyone can enter it without Xu Junbai's permission, and they may die without knowing how.
After death, there is no place to cry. This place is an important place for the sect. If you want to enter it without the permission of the sect, you will face the fate of being killed.
"I have met Senior Brother Song. I wonder if Senior Brother Song has any good news to tell Junior Brother?"
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo came over and whispered: "Junior Brother Xu, did you know? Junior Brother Luan Ling is back."
Xu Junbai frowned.
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo continued: "That's Junior Brother Luan Ling. He's back. He came back three days ago. I'm sure you don't know yet, Senior Brother. As soon as I got the news, Senior Brother, I came here to tell you. How about it? Senior Brother, I'm a brother."
Xu Junbai asked: "He's back, what next."
Song Zhenluo said with a smile: "He is dead, Junior Brother Xu."
When Xu Junbai heard this, he waved his hands quickly.
"I didn't kill the person, Senior Brother Song, please don't slander me."
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo had a dark look on his face and said quickly: "Okay, I know you weren't the one who killed him. Senior Brother Luan Ling was killed by the demon clan when he broke through to collect souls outside. If the elders of our sect hadn't gone there, I'm afraid we wouldn't even have seen his body."
"I heard it was very tragic. Half of the body was gone. He couldn't die anymore. The elders of the sect were almost left in that place. Junior Brother Xu, what's wrong with you?"
"It's nothing." Xu Junbai said, "Senior brother, continue."
"The demon tribe is really abominable. They dared to kill our disciples of the Baiyun Sect. This time they completely angered the elders of the sect. It is said that they will arrange for the disciples to go down the mountain to kill the demons."
"I also heard that disciples from every mountain peak need to go down the mountain and be led by their elders to kill the monsters."
"This time, some of the monsters around us are going to suffer."
Xu Junbai frowned again.
Going down the mountain? Kill demons?
Not what he wanted.
"Then senior brother, you want to go down the mountain too?"
Song Zhenluo shook his head: "There is no chance for ordinary disciples like me, it's all for the sake of gold plating, you know."
Xu Junbai understood. This time he went down the mountain to slay demons and slay demons. If he made a lot of contributions, he would naturally get a lot of rewards. This kind of beneficial thing would not be possible for people like them who had no backing. If they wanted to go, they might not be able to go.
They were all the disciples with a backstage who went down the mountain to slay demons and eliminate demons, just going through the motions. Anyway, there was no danger as the elders were with them.
It's basically a solid achievement, and it's not impossible to get a spiritual weapon by then.
There are many rewards for elixirs and magical weapons, and many people are jealous of them.
But, I can't go.
"Junior brother, do you want to go?"
"No, I don't want to."
"Hahaha."
